question: In what proportion relative to Śiva should the limbs be satisfied, according to the address to the twice-born?
premises: The instruction is addressed to the best of the twice-born.
Their measure is a tenth part relative to Śiva.
inference: O best of the twice-born, one should satisfy the limbs by a tenth part relative to Śiva.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, one should satisfy the limbs with a tenth part of what is offered to Śiva.
